claims.statement: A match between Tom Allen and Mike McCoole for March 17, 1868 was called off without any money being forfeited.
claims.excerpt: to come offon the 17th, was Gngen Wi out any money being forfeited.

claims.statement: Tom Allen intended to challenge the champion, or to accept McCoole's proposal to fight, and would go for the conqueror.
claims.excerpt: Allen, who intends to chailenge the champion; or

fights.stakes: $310 put up by backers (Rider and Pendergast for McCoole; Carroll, Looney and Roach for Allen); neither principal put up money
fights.excerpt: to come offon the 17th, was Gngen Wi out any money being forfeited.
fights.notes: Match made by friends, then called off without forfeit. The OCR of the key verb ('Gngen Wi') is unclear; the title says it was called off.

notes: The challenge wording is badly garbled. The stake details are in the notes column of the fight entry. Other items on the page are not about Allen.
